name: MailMergeDataSource
description: Represents the mail merge data source in a mail merge operation.
remarks: Use the DataSource property to return the MailMergeDataSource object. The following example displays the name of the data source associated with the active document. The following example displays the field names in the data source associated with the active document. The following example opens the data source associated with Form letter.doc and determines whether the FirstName field includes the name "Kate."

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified MailMergeDataSource object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns name of the specified object. Read-only String.

properties.name: HeaderSourceName
properties.description: Returns the path and file name of the header source attached to the specified mail merge main document. Read-only String.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the type of mail merge data source. Read-only WdMailMergeDataSource.

properties.name: HeaderSourceType
properties.description: Returns a value that indicates the way the header source is being supplied for the mail merge operation. Read-only WdMailMergeDataSource.

properties.name: ConnectString
properties.description: Returns the connection string for the specified mail merge data source. Read-only String.

properties.name: QueryString
properties.description: Returns or sets the query string (SQL statement) used to retrieve a subset of the data in a mail merge data source. Read/write String.

properties.name: ActiveRecord
properties.description: Returns or sets the active mail merge record. Can be either a valid record number in the query result or one of the WdMailMergeActiveRecord constants.

properties.name: FirstRecord
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of the first record to be merged in a mail merge operation. Read/write Long.

properties.name: LastRecord
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of the last record to be merged in a mail merge operation. Read/write Long.

properties.name: FieldNames
properties.description: Returns a MailMergeFieldNames collection that represents the names of all the fields in the specified mail merge data source. Read-only.

properties.name: DataFields
properties.description: Returns a MailMergeDataFields collection that represents the fields in the specified mail merge data source. Read-only.

properties.name: RecordCount
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of records in the data source. Read-only.

properties.name: Included
properties.description: True if a record is included in a mail merge. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: InvalidAddress
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to mark a record in a mail merge data source if it contains invalid data in an address field. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: InvalidComments
properties.description: If the InvalidAddress property is True, returns or sets a String that describes an invalid address error. Read/write.

properties.name: MappedDataFields
properties.description: Returns a MappedDataFields collection that represents the mapped data fields available in Microsoft Word.

properties.name: TableName
properties.description: Returns a String with the SQL query used to retrieve the records from the data source file attached to a mail merge document. Read-only.

methods.name: FindRecord
methods.signature: FindRecord(FindText As String, [Field As Variant]) As Boolean
methods.description: Searches the contents of the specified mail merge data source for text in a particular field. Returns True if the search text is found. Boolean.

parameters.name: FindText
parameters.description: The text to be looked for.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: The name of the field to be searched.

methods.name: SetAllIncludedFlags
methods.description: Includes or excludes flagged records in a data source from a mail merge.

parameters.name: Included
parameters.description: True to include all data source records in a mail merge. False to exclude all data source records from a mail merge.

methods.name: SetAllErrorFlags
methods.signature: SetAllErrorFlags(Invalid As Boolean, InvalidComment As String)
methods.description: Marks all records in a mail merge data source as containing invalid data in an address field.

parameters.name: Invalid
parameters.description: True marks all records in the data source of a mail merge as invalid.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the specified Mail Merge data source.
